# json/write

> Writing JSON: json_write for one line, json_pretty for indented output.

truck [json](../json.md) · [source](../../../registry/json/write.pkg)

```
let o = json_obj()
json_set(o, "name", json_str("Ada \"Lovelace\""))
json_set(o, "year", json_int(1843))
print json_write(o)
// {"name":"Ada \"Lovelace\"","year":1843}
print json_pretty(o, 2)
// {
//   "name": "Ada \"Lovelace\"",
//   "year": 1843
// }
```

| function | gives |
|---|---|
| `json_write(j: ptr Json) -> str` | compact JSON, with no spaces |
| `json_pretty(j: ptr Json, indent: int) -> str` | one item per line, nested `indent` spaces deeper; empty arrays and objects as `[]` and `{}` |
| `json_quote(s: str) -> str` | `s` as a JSON string: `"` and `\` escaped, control characters as `\n`, `\t`, ... or `\u00XX`; other bytes kept |

Objects are written in key order, numbers as their text, and `null`
pointers as `null`. Parsing what `json_write` gives returns the same tree.

## Library code

Merged into every program that uses this package.

```
fn json_quote(s: str) -> str
  let b = sb_new()
  json_quote_to(b, s)
  return sb_str(b)
end

fn json_quote_to(b: ptr StrBuf, s: str)
  sb_byte(b, '"')
  for i = 0 to len(s) - 1
    let c = s[i]
    if c == '"'
      sb_add(b, "\\\"")
    elif c == '\\'
      sb_add(b, "\\\\")
    elif c == '\n'
      sb_add(b, "\\n")
    elif c == '\t'
      sb_add(b, "\\t")
    elif c == '\r'
      sb_add(b, "\\r")
    elif c < ' '
      sb_add(b, "\\u00")
      sb_hex(b, c as int)
    else
      sb_byte(b, c)
    end
  end
  sb_byte(b, '"')
end

fn json_write(j: ptr Json) -> str
  let b = sb_new()
  json_emit(b, j, -1, 0)
  return sb_str(b)
end

fn json_pretty(j: ptr Json, indent: int) -> str
  let b = sb_new()
  let n = indent
  if n < 0
    n = 0
  end
  json_emit(b, j, n, 0)
  return sb_str(b)
end

fn json_newline(b: ptr StrBuf, indent: int, depth: int)
  if indent < 0
    return
  end
  sb_byte(b, '\n')
  for k = 1 to indent * depth
    sb_byte(b, ' ')
  end
end

// json_emit writes j; indent < 0 is compact.
fn json_emit(b: ptr StrBuf, j: ptr Json, indent: int, depth: int)
  let k = json_kind(j)
  if k == JSON_NULL
    sb_add(b, "null")
  elif k == JSON_BOOL
    if j.b
      sb_add(b, "true")
    else
      sb_add(b, "false")
    end
  elif k == JSON_NUM
    sb_add(b, j.num)
  elif k == JSON_STR
    json_quote_to(b, j.s)
  elif k == JSON_ARR
    if vec_len(j.items) == 0
      sb_add(b, "[]")
      return
    end
    sb_byte(b, '[')
    for i = 0 to vec_len(j.items) - 1
      if i > 0
        sb_byte(b, ',')
      end
      json_newline(b, indent, depth + 1)
      json_emit(b, vec_get(j.items, i) as ptr Json, indent, depth + 1)
    end
    json_newline(b, indent, depth)
    sb_byte(b, ']')
  else
    if map_len(j.obj) == 0
      sb_add(b, "{}")
      return
    end
    sb_byte(b, '{')
    for i = 0 to map_len(j.obj) - 1
      if i > 0
        sb_byte(b, ',')
      end
      json_newline(b, indent, depth + 1)
      json_quote_to(b, map_key(j.obj, i))
      sb_byte(b, ':')
      if indent >= 0
        sb_byte(b, ' ')
      end
      json_emit(b, map_value(j.obj, i) as ptr Json, indent, depth + 1)
    end
    json_newline(b, indent, depth)
    sb_byte(b, '}')
  end
end
```
